milestone: M4-ONLINE online banking dataset acquisition (revised M4 strategy)
status_scope: Strongest available controlled benchmark acquired, validated and split. No openly accessible genuine English handwritten cheque dataset was obtainable (IDRBT unreachable, ORAND-CAR gated); cheque-level paired fields are SYNTHETIC. Genuine and synthetic sets are separated throughout.
strategy_change: custom handwriting collection retired by student decision; ArUco sheet workflow kept as optional utility; M4-PILOT superseded (not passed)
datasets_investigated: Kaggle and Google Dataset Search not queried (account / JS app)
ground_truth: dataset annotations; values from int(digits), an explicit number-word table, or an independent verbaliser lookup; never LoGo-HTR, never the evaluated parsers; no human verification claimed
annotation_findings: D6 annotations match the rendered text for all 130 cheques viewed (AI visual check)
D6 has 14 natural numeric/words discrepancies and 24 blank fields
D5 possible label noise (stroke-like '1', '80' vs '82', tiny crops); not relabelled
CVL writer ids inferred (121/127 ids hold exactly one of each string)
pending_audit_fixes_resolved: duplicate annotation ids raise instead of collapsing
numeric grammar ASCII [0-9] only; supported currencies Rs/Rs./PKR only
baseline_update: region extraction = dataset-provided images (CVL), annotation polygon boxes (GNHK), template oracle boxes (synthetic); recogniser unchanged
key_limitations: no genuine handwritten cheque with both amount fields
genuine written amounts limited to 27 single number words (1-11)
cheque-level pairs are synthetic font renders
CVL: 10 fixed strings, no punctuation/currency, non-commercial licence
no human verification of online labels
